_about: Story state, reader-safe. Claude-owned. Update after every scene and climax. Never put real-world numbers here; GM-only state (plan, flags, factions, companions to come) lives in saga/state/_gm/plan.json and approval moves only through saga.py add. covers lists the days a scene drew on; whether a day is closed lives in the Ledger, not here. The site's Now page gives each field one job, so a fact belongs in one of them: last_beat is the latest scene or Between, current_quest.on_the_page the quest, current_struggle what he is fighting (a sentence or two), location.detail where he is (a phrase); a companion's line there is their character file's last_seen_doing.

location.detail: the infirmary hall on the feast morning, on his cot by Hollis's; Hollis has eaten and has Benedek's hand back in both of his
location._about: place is an id from saga/state/places.json; detail is a short phrase, where in the place he is (the site prints it after the place's name). Weather is season's, events are last_beat's

season: first snow of the year on the Steps

current_quest.name: The List
current_quest.on_the_page: The Confessors have come for the Faithless at Saint Ysolde's with a list: Darrow first, Hollis second. The named are to be taken down the Steps to the Oathspire and made to kneel where everyone can watch, which would say the Ninth drowned for its own bad faith, and would tear the thread in Darrow's knee. What stands between them and the hall is Old Mercy, the sanctuary bell: while it rings at dawn and dusk, no blade passes the gate and no name under it is taken down against its will. Miss one ringing and the law lapses till the next, and Sister Pell, who rings it, is very old. At the gate, Confessor Ivo Marrant read his names at the bars, and two of his men came through the wicket before the bell rang, late. Now five grey cloaks are camped on the lower terrace below the gate, and the sixth holds the winch-house, the cage and Rae's cart, so the road is theirs. Marrant's price: the Captain of the Ninth comes down and kneels, and the rest of the paper goes back in his cloak. Darrow went to the bars and gave him his name and his face. Marrant says he will wait.
current_quest._about: on_the_page is what the site shows and must be supported by the chronicle; the GM's own summary lives in saga/state/_gm/plan.json (quest_summary). One job: the quest itself (who wants what, what stands in the way, the price), not the latest scene (last_beat) or what he is fighting (current_struggle)

current_struggle: The soft season, and the waiting. Maelis read the knee after the wicket and found it held, and said it is still soft and will be at the thaw; the quiet is a liar. He cannot kneel, and has asked fifteen times to go down the Steps and been told no fifteen times. Now Benedek lies Hollowed in the next cot but one, with frost on his mouth and glass under his tongue, and nobody passed.
last_beat: The feast morning, after Maelis sent him to make Hollis eat. Darrow fetched half a feast loaf from the kitchen (the novice wrote it in the book) and set it on the blanket. Hollis would not let go of Benedek's hand: "I'll eat when he does." "He's not going to, Hollis." Darrow saw that the thick hands were still only while they held something, as over the knucklebones, and offered: "Give him to me. For the length of a loaf." "He's Sixth." "I know whose he is." He put the bread into Hollis's right hand, closed the fingers on it, and took the lad's hand out of the left; Hollis ate all of it the way men eat after a battle, and the hand never shook because it was never empty. Then he held out his palm and took the lad's hand back. "Tell her I ate. Don't tell her how."

maelis.note: has told him what she dared, and not where she learned it; the Confessor's eyes found her at the gate; she approved his name at the bars in her own coin

hollis.note: second on the list, read at the bars; dry, and has told Darrow so; saw him move at his name, and called him Captain when he gave it

wren.note: afraid; hides it with numbers; ran for the bell on his word; made him promise to tell her first next time

choices.text: Tell the lay brothers the Faithless went down the far side a week ago. Let the valley carry it.
Step forward and answer to his name.

inventory: a borrowed stick he refuses to use

recaps._about: One-line 'previously' per chapter file slug, shown at the top of that chapter in the reader. Spoiler-free; only what earlier chapters showed.
recaps.01-the-confessor-at-the-steps: At Harrow Ford the Grace went out of the Ninth Lance in mid-river, and only a thread of it came back; Darrow's knee gave way with no blade near it, and forty-one of his sixty did not come home. Carried up the Thousand Steps to Saint Ysolde's, he chose Maelis Vorne's Binding over kneeling again at the Oathspire.
recaps.02-the-grey-cot: In the hour before dusk the grey cloaks climbed to the gate, and Confessor Ivo Marrant read his list to the House, Darrow's name first. Two of his men came through the wicket before Old Mercy rang, late, and Darrow's shoulder could not shut it. The Prior spoke the law of names, and Marrant made his camp on the lower terrace to wait for the Captain of the Ninth to come down and kneel. Darrow went to the bars and gave him his name and his face.
